[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra IV.3 (Kaivalyapāda) — Nimittam aprayojakaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ varaṇa-bhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat | Pages 690-694]

aṃ tv āsāṃ bhinatti, tasmin bhinne svayam eva–āpaḥ kedāra-
antaram āplāvayanti, tathā dharmaḥ prakṛtīnām āvaraṇam adharmaṃ bhinatti, tasmin bhinne
svayam eva prakṛtayaḥ svaṃ svaṃ vikāram
1761 āplāvayanti / Yathā vā sa eva kṣetrikas tasminn
eva kedāre na prabhavaty audakān bhaumān vā rasān dhānya-mūlāny anupraveśayitum /
Kiṃ tarhi mudga-gavedhuka-śyāmāka-ādīṃs
1762 tato'pakarṣati / Apakṛṣṭeṣu teṣu svayam eva
rasā dhānya-mūlāny anupraviśanti, tathā dharmo nivṛtti-mātre kāraṇam adharmasya,
śuddhy-aśuddhyor atyanta-virodhāt / Na tu prakṛti-pravṛttau dharmo hetur bhavati–iti / Atra
nandīśvara-ādaya udāhāryāḥ / Viparyayeṇa–apy adharmo dharmaṃ bādhate / Tataś ca–
aśuddhi-pariṇ
